description: Change a message: mark it read or unread, or replace its labels (the list replaces them all; an empty list removes them). precondition_failed means other changes landed first: repeat it unchanged. Labels replace whole and the last write wins, so read the message again before repeating a label change much later.

changes.description: At least one of read and labels.

read.description: true marks it read, false unread.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. The same key repeats this change instead of applying it twice; never reuse one for a different change.

name: bud_put
